chunks: He replied: 'Should I trust you with him as I did his brother before? But God is the best of guardians, and most merciful of all.'
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Jacob say when entrusting Joseph to his brothers?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Jacob (Yaqub) addresses his sons, noting that while he trusted them with Joseph previously, their track record was imperfect, prompting him to rely on divine protection. This highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the transition from human fallibility to absolute trust in Allah (Al-Hafiz) as the ultimate guardian. The verse concludes with a declaration of God's superior mercy, reinforcing the theological principle that divine care surpasses all earthly safeguards.
